title: Launch Accelerator: Lighthouse Seed Cohort & Closed Beta Feedback Cadence
creator: Laura Chen
description:
Objective: Stand up a repeatable 'Launch Accelerator' play for lighthouse accounts and closed-beta customers that (1) accelerates meaningful product validation, (2) surfaces showstopper bugs before wide release, and (3) collects high-signal product, UX, and cost telemetry to inform rollout decisions.

Scope: Run a 6-week seeded closed beta with 6 lighthouse customers across ML platforms and customer-facing apps. Deliverables: onboarding kit, runbook for SRE/Support, weekly feedback digest, structured release notes template, prioritized bug backlog, and a post-beta decision memo.

Milestones:
- Week 0 (pre-launch): confirm cohort + legal/data terms, finalize onboarding docs, prepare dedicated monitoring dashboard and feature flags.
- Week 1: onboarding calls (setup & test prompts), baseline perf and correctness collection.
- Weeks 2–5: active beta; weekly feedback syncs, rolling bug triage, docs updates, and release notes drafts.
- Week 6: close beta, export telemetry, run cross-functional review, and publish decision (go/no-go + rollout plan).

Acceptance criteria:
- >80% of lighthouse accounts successfully complete onboarding within 3 business days.
- No Sev1 incidents caused by Lighthouse traffic during beta.
- Quality regressions (measured via eval prompt set) remain within agreed thresholds.
- Actionable feedback items (>= 10 high/medium items) logged and prioritized.

Cross-team responsibilities:
- Product (owner): playbook, prioritization, weekly digests, decision memo.
- Eng (runtime, infra): dedicated routing policy, capacity reservation, observability dashboards, incident runbook.
- Design: onboarding flows, UX feedback capture templates, sample prompts.
- Docs & DevRel: onboarding kit, release notes templates, customer-facing changelog.
- SRE & Support: on-call coverage schedule, escalation matrix, runbook.
- Legal/Privacy: approve data collection & retention approach for beta telemetry.
- Sales/CS: identify lighthouse customers, coordinate kickoff and feedback cadence, arrange exec demos.

Release notes & comms coordination:
- Produce a focused 'Lighthouse Beta' release note draft at Week 0; iterate weekly with engineer and design inputs.
- Maintain a single shared Google Doc (link below) for release-note content and approvals.
- Communications checklist includes: in-product banner for participants, customer-facing email templates, internal TL;DR for Ops/Support, and a short technical summary for partner engineering teams.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Overloaded infra causing noisy results. Mitigation: reserve Dedicated capacity pool + controlled traffic ramp.
- Risk: Low engagement from customers. Mitigation: prioritize accounts with established partnerships and provide a clear success package (early access to features, dedicated onboarding).

Success metrics (to inform go/no-go): activation rate, median time-to-first-successful-call, token cost delta vs baseline, number of high-priority bugs found, and CS qualitative sentiment score.

Artifacts: onboarding kit, monitoring dashboard, release-notes doc, runbook, post-beta decision memo. Links provided in attachments.

notes_for_release_notes: Keep the release note concise: 3 bullets for feature highlights, 1 bullet for known limitations, 1 paragraph on expected customer benefit, and a short 'how we measured success' line. Link to participant guide and opt-in details. Ensure two approvers (PM + Eng) before sending to customers.
